blast: low — quill's project spec is status: draft with no frozen suite anywhere, and doc-impl-bar/doc-spec-bar are reference nodes carrying no .feature, so nothing freezes or re-freezes. The retraction only widens (a criterion that used to fail now passes) and the defect catalog ships entirely advisory, so no document that passes today starts failing. The one narrowing is the spec bar's path-coverage rule, which applies to specs authored from here on.
approach: retract recurrence at every site — it has no empirical warrant (.research/documentation-craft/, E03)
re-partition by what reaches the verdict: inspection keeps the enumeration rule, everything prose-semantic moves to judgment
author the defect catalog in the existing quill-builder-impl rather than a new bar — a catalog entry is a bar, not a per-document contract
borrow ACED's blind two-pass asymmetry, not its threshold plumbing
ship advisory; calibration is what earns an entry its blocking power

title: a frozen, implemented ACED scenario specifies an edge that cannot fire
note: registry.feature:75 'a squad missing its governances block is rejected' freezes the same unreachable behavior that init-quill's step 3 states in prose: the skill constructs the only payload it ever writes and that payload always carries a governances block, so the validation cannot be reached from inside its own workflow. Unlike the quill instance this one is @frozen, in a project spec at status: implemented — so an impl gate passed against a scenario no implementation can lose. Found by the quill registry spec-producer while deciding not to make the same mistake; it left the edge unspecified and recorded why under its own ## Control Flow. Worth asking how the ACED impl gate returned PASS on it, since that answer generalizes beyond this scenario.

line 62's governances-block rejection has no reachable trigger. Two exits: delete the rule, or make it reachable by having step 3 validate the FOUND entry — a quill entry already in squads[] shape whose squad lacks governances should be treated as an older shape and rewritten to canonical rather than classified up-to-date and left alone. The second is the useful form: it is the only path by which a hand-edited or partially-migrated registry ever gets repaired. Either way the registry node's spec and suite need a matching amendment; as authored they specify only what the skill can currently do.
title: init-quill's governances rejection is unreachable, and the useful fix is to validate the found entry
